about: Shared expectations for decimal miles: 0.5/0.25/0.75 mi are a half / a quarter mile / three quarters of a mile, N.5/N.25/N.75 mi are 'N and a half/quarter/three quarters miles', other 0.x mi drop the leading zero ('point three miles'); 1.3 mi keeps 'one point three'; km and m untouched; numbers glued to something before them are left; after a/an/the/this/that/each/every the half or quarter takes no article ('the half mile road', 'every quarter mile', 'that three quarter mile climb'; BookLyre I-190, CROSS X-041), 'bathe 0.5 mi' and 'in 0.5 mi' keep 'a half mile'. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_distances.json). EpubToM4B can port the same rule; keep both copies in sync.
